Owner: WP02 (manifest/cases) with WP01 (persona text) and WP03 (sop-extract text) as the other two inputs; disposition is an operator decision (retune the case `expected` blocks, add a `precedence:` block, or amend FR-004), not an accept-gate one. THE VERDICT IS RECORDED AS `fail` DELIBERATELY: the criterion as this mission normatively states it (1.1.0) genuinely fails, and flipping it to `pass` on the strength of a version pin that appears in no normative artifact would be making the board green rather than making the record true.
